title: Create repository foundation and CI
acceptance_criteria: CI passes; packaging and contributor docs exist.

title: Implement canonical Pydantic domain models
acceptance_criteria: Models reject unknown fields and export versioned schemas.

title: Implement split project-contract loader
acceptance_criteria: Example contract loads, hashes, and validates references.

title: Implement stable IDs and canonical hashing
acceptance_criteria: Hashes are deterministic across runs and ordering.

title: Implement append-only hash-chained SQLite ledger
acceptance_criteria: Append, verify, export, and mutation-denial tests pass.

title: Implement TPPR calculation
acceptance_criteria: Known event fixture produces expected TPPR and pending persistence list.

title: Build deterministic evidence compiler
acceptance_criteria: Candidate produces schema-valid packet and recommendation.

title: Implement Git revision normalization
acceptance_criteria: Invalid revisions fail with actionable errors.

title: Implement conservative Lean diff classifier
acceptance_criteria: Golden diffs classify declarations and escalate unknown changes.

title: Implement isolated exact-environment runner
acceptance_criteria: Timeout, environment allowlist, output limit, and logs are tested.

title: Add container sandbox backend
acceptance_criteria: Build runs without network or CI secrets.

title: Implement placeholder and prohibited-token checks
acceptance_criteria: Configured tokens cause deterministic hard failure.

title: Implement changed-path policy gate
acceptance_criteria: Denied paths reject the candidate.

title: Implement risk classifier R0–R4
acceptance_criteria: Representative fixtures map to expected risk classes.

title: Implement decision gate policy
acceptance_criteria: Hard fail, accept-eligible, and escalation branches are covered.

title: Render JSON and Markdown evidence packets
acceptance_criteria: Outputs preserve every finding and provenance field.

title: Implement review operation
acceptance_criteria: Review question, decision, and time events work end to end.

title: Implement deterministic review-question routing
acceptance_criteria: Semantic uncertainty outranks stylistic issues.

title: Implement reviewer authority checks
acceptance_criteria: R3/R4 decisions require configured roles.

title: Implement review decision recording
acceptance_criteria: Decision and review minutes append to ledger.

title: Implement GitHub Check output adapter
acceptance_criteria: Packet summary and review question appear as a check.

title: Build Lean extraction adapter
acceptance_criteria: Adapter works inside the target toolchain and emits protocol JSON.

title: Extract declaration metadata and signature hashes
acceptance_criteria: Changed declarations are resolved without lexical heuristics.

title: Extract axiom dependencies and placeholders
acceptance_criteria: Report matches known fixtures.

title: Extract direct dependency graph
acceptance_criteria: Edges are stable and content-addressed.

title: Compute transitive impact cone
acceptance_criteria: Impact cone matches a hand-audited fixture.

title: Detect import and dependency expansion
acceptance_criteria: Packet reports new and removed dependencies.

title: Implement semantic evidence providers
acceptance_criteria: Providers emit independent, provenance-complete findings.

title: Implement statement signature diff
acceptance_criteria: Binder, assumptions, domains, and conclusions are compared.

title: Implement project example runner
acceptance_criteria: Declared examples generate structured evidence.

title: Implement counterexample-provider protocol
acceptance_criteria: Provider failure remains UNKNOWN and never silently passes.

title: Implement repository duplicate retrieval
acceptance_criteria: Closest declarations and provenance are reported.

title: Implement downstream replacement tests
acceptance_criteria: Selected successor declarations compile against candidate.

title: Run first shadow-mode project pilot
acceptance_criteria: 30–50 prospective candidates with complete expert-time data.

title: Select and instrument first active repository
acceptance_criteria: Contract and obligations are accepted by project lead.

title: Freeze review experiment and analysis
acceptance_criteria: Three conditions and decision gates are preregistered.

title: Measure contract and instrumentation overhead
acceptance_criteria: Overhead is below 10% or protocol is narrowed.

title: Publish pilot evidence and limitations
acceptance_criteria: Results distinguish software performance from causal conclusions.

title: Learn review routing from utility outcomes
acceptance_criteria: Held-out TPPR proxy improves over deterministic routing.

title: Evaluate project-targeted data synthesis
acceptance_criteria: Equal-budget training improves held-out TPPR.
